list.systemDescription: Predefined and unchangeable. You can assign them to members.
list.customDescription: Bundle permissions for the way you work, for example sales or support.
list.emptyDescription: Custom roles give members exactly the permissions they need. Create one as soon as the “Member” system role allows too much or too little.

dialog.description: Changes apply to every assigned member from their next request.
dialog.viewDescription: System roles are predefined. This is what they allow.
dialog.conflict: Someone just changed this role. Your input is kept – compare it with the current state before saving again.

errors.ROLE_NOT_FOUND: This role no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some details are missing. Check name and permissions.
errors.ROLE_NAME_TAKEN: A role with this name already exists.
errors.ROLE_NAME_RESERVED: A system role already uses this name. Pick a distinct name so the roles stay recognizable.
errors.PERMISSION_NOT_DELEGABLE: Administration permissions are reserved for the owner role. Remove them from the selection.
errors.ROLE_PERMISSION_NOT_SCOPE_ASSIGNABLE: A scope-assignable role may only contain scope-assignable permissions.
errors.ROLE_SCOPE_ASSIGNMENTS_EXIST: This role still has scoped assignments and cannot be reset.
errors.ROLE_WORKSPACE_ASSIGNMENTS_EXIST: This role is still assigned workspace-wide and cannot become scope-assignable. Remove it from the members first.
errors.INTERNAL: That did not work. Try again.
